-- ============================================================
-- V91: CRIS QA test harness
-- Stores reproducible n8n QA runs, cases, findings and shadow outbox.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cris_qa_digits(p_phone text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
AS $$
  SELECT regexp_replace(coalesce(p_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g')
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cris_qa_normalize_phone(p_phone text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql
IMMUTABLE
AS $$
DECLARE
  d text := cris_qa_digits(p_phone);
BEGIN
  IF d = '' THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  IF left(d, 3) = '593' THEN
    RETURN '+' || d;
  END IF;

  IF left(d, 1) = '0' AND length(d) = 10 THEN
    RETURN '+593' || substring(d from 2);
  END IF;

  IF left(d, 1) = '9' AND length(d) = 9 THEN
    RETURN '+593' || d;
  END IF;

  RETURN '+' || d;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cris_test_allowed_leads (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  phone_raw   text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  phone_e164  text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (cris_qa_normalize_phone(phone_raw)) STORED,
  label       text,
  active      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  notes       text,
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_cris_test_allowed_leads_e164
  ON cris_test_allowed_leads(phone_e164)
  WHERE phone_e164 IS NOT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cris_qa_is_allowed_phone(p_phone text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cris_test_allowed_leads a
    WHERE a.active = true
      AND (
        cris_qa_digits(a.phone_raw) = cris_qa_digits(p_phone)
        OR a.phone_e164 = cris_qa_normalize_phone(p_phone)
      )
  )
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cris_test_runs (
  id                     uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  run_key                text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  delivery_mode          text NOT NULL CHECK (delivery_mode IN ('shadow', 'live', 'hybrid')),
  allow_public_messages  boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  requested_windows      text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY['3m']::text[],
  scenario_groups        text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY[]::text[],
  input                  jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  summary                jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  status                 text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RUNNING'
                         CHECK (status IN ('RUNNING', 'PASSED', 'FAILED', 'PARTIAL', 'CANCELLED')),
  created_by             text,
  error                  text,
  started_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  finished_at            timestamptz,
  created_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cris_test_runs_status
  ON cris_test_runs(status, started_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cris_test_cases (
  id                   uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  run_id               uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES cris_test_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  scenario_id          text NOT NULL,
  scenario_group       text NOT NULL,
  window_profile       text NOT NULL CHECK (window_profile IN ('3m', '1h', '24h')),
  delivery_mode        text NOT NULL CHECK (delivery_mode IN ('shadow', 'live')),
  phone                text NOT NULL,
  phone_e164           text,
  lead_id              uuid,
  conversation_id      uuid,
  chatwoot_conv_id     integer,
  chatwoot_contact_id  integer,
  status               text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'
                       CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'PASSED', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED', 'CLEANED')),
  severity             text CHECK (severity IN ('P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4')),
  expected             jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  actual               jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  assertions           jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  execution_ids        jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  repro_payload        jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  snapshot_before      jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  snapshot_after       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  cleanup_status       text,
  error                text,
  started_at           timestamptz,
  finished_at          timestamptz,
  created_at           timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at           timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (run_id, scenario_id, window_profile, delivery_mode, phone)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cris_test_cases_run
  ON cris_test_cases(run_id, status);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cris_test_cases_conv
  ON cris_test_cases(conversation_id)
  WHERE conversation_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cris_test_outbox (
  id                       uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  run_id                   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES cris_test_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  case_id                  uuid REFERENCES cris_test_cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  delivery_mode            text NOT NULL CHECK (delivery_mode IN ('shadow', 'live')),
  channel                  text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'whatsapp',
  target_phone             text,
  target_conversation_id   uuid,
  message_type             text,
  would_send_payload       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  sent                     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  external_status          text,
  external_response        jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cris_test_outbox_case
  ON cris_test_outbox(case_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cris_test_findings (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  run_id          uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES cris_test_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  case_id         uuid REFERENCES cris_test_cases(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  severity        text NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4')),
  title           text NOT NULL,
  expected        jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  actual          jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  suspected_node  text,
  evidence        jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  repro_payload   jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  status          text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN'
                  CHECK (status IN ('OPEN', 'CONFIRMED', 'RESOLVED', 'WONTFIX')),
  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cris_test_findings_run
  ON cris_test_findings(run_id, severity, status);

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_cris_test_allowed_leads_updated_at ON cris_test_allowed_leads;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cris_test_allowed_leads_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON cris_test_allowed_leads
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_cris_test_runs_updated_at ON cris_test_runs;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cris_test_runs_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON cris_test_runs
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_cris_test_cases_updated_at ON cris_test_cases;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cris_test_cases_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON cris_test_cases
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_cris_test_findings_updated_at ON cris_test_findings;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cris_test_findings_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON cris_test_findings
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

INSERT INTO cris_test_allowed_leads (phone_raw, label, notes)
VALUES
  ('0998299109', 'Luis Rocha QA', 'Default CRIS QA allowlist lead'),
  ('21999910781', 'CRIS QA lead 2', 'Default CRIS QA allowlist lead')
ON CONFLICT (phone_raw) DO UPDATE
SET active = true,
    label = EXCLUDED.label,
    notes = EXCLUDED.notes,
    updated_at = now();

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cris_test_run_summary AS
SELECT
  r.id AS run_id,
  r.run_key,
  r.delivery_mode,
  r.status,
  r.started_at,
  r.finished_at,
  count(DISTINCT c.id)::integer AS case_count,
  count(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'PASSED')::integer AS passed_count,
  count(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'FAILED')::integer AS failed_count,
  count(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'SKIPPED')::integer AS skipped_count,
  count(DISTINCT f.id) FILTER (WHERE f.status IN ('OPEN', 'CONFIRMED'))::integer AS open_findings_count
FROM cris_test_runs r
LEFT JOIN cris_test_cases c ON c.run_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN cris_test_findings f ON f.run_id = r.id
GROUP BY r.id;


INSERT INTO flyway_schema_history (installed_rank, version, description, type, script, checksum, installed_by, execution_time, success)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(installed_rank) FROM flyway_schema_history), 0) + 1, '91', 'cris_qa_test_harness', 'SQL', 'V91__cris_qa_test_harness.sql', 919748266, 'n8n-cris-qa', 0, true
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE version = '91');

SELECT 'V91__cris_qa_test_harness.sql' AS script, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE version = '91' AND success = true) AS recorded;
